Name: PHANTOM_PARAM_ST
Description: Settings for phantom and spirit appearances. Unused in AC6.

Fields.Name: Edge Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Alpha component of the edge (rim) colour.

Fields.Name: Front Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Alpha component of the front (facing) colour.

Fields.Name: Diffuse Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Alpha component of the diffuse multiplier colour.

Fields.Name: Specular Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Alpha component of the specular multiplier colour.

Fields.Name: Light Color: Alpha
Fields.Description: Alpha component of the light colour.

Fields.Name: Edge Color: R
Fields.Description: Red component of the edge (rim) colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Edge Color: G
Fields.Description: Green component of the edge (rim) colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Edge Color: B
Fields.Description: Blue component of the edge (rim) colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Front Color: R
Fields.Description: Red component of the front (facing) colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Front Color: G
Fields.Description: Green component of the front (facing) colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Front Color: B
Fields.Description: Blue component of the front (facing) colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Diffuse Color: R
Fields.Description: Red component of the diffuse multiplier colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Diffuse Color: G
Fields.Description: Green component of the diffuse multiplier colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Diffuse Color: B
Fields.Description: Blue component of the diffuse multiplier colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Specular Color: R
Fields.Description: Red component of the specular multiplier colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Specular Color: G
Fields.Description: Green component of the specular multiplier colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Specular Color: B
Fields.Description: Blue component of the specular multiplier colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Light Color: R
Fields.Description: Red component of the light colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Light Color: G
Fields.Description: Green component of the light colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Light Color: B
Fields.Description: Blue component of the light colour. 0-255.

Fields.Name: Overall Alpha
Fields.Description: Overall transparency of the phantom.

Fields.Name: Blend Rate
Fields.Description: Blend ratio of the phantom effect.

Fields.Name: Blend Type
Fields.Description: Alpha blend mode of the phantom effect.

Fields.Name: Perform Edge Color Subtraction
Fields.Description: If ON, the edge colour is subtracted instead of added.

Fields.Name: Perform Front Color Subtraction
Fields.Description: If ON, the front colour is subtracted instead of added.

Fields.Name: Single Pass Only
Fields.Description: If ON, the second rendering pass is skipped.

Fields.Name: Edge Width
Fields.Description: Width of the edge (rim) glow.

Fields.Name: Glow Strength
Fields.Description: Strength of the glow. 0: no glow.
